claims.claim: Writes an OSC 777 notification sequence containing the supplied title and body to standard output.
Writes the Kitty OSC 99 title and body as two standard-output sequences.
Builds a Windows Runtime toast command whose text comes from the supplied body and whose notifier name comes from the supplied title.
Invokes PowerShell with NoProfile and the generated toast command without a completion callback.
Chooses the Windows branch from WT_SESSION, the Kitty branch from KITTY_WINDOW_ID, and OSC 777 for every other environment.
Registers an agent_end hook that dispatches only the fixed title Pi and body Ready for input.
The notification functions emit escape sequences or start PowerShell without reporting a delivery outcome through Pi.
